breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to fix this inconsistency. Instead of removing the incorrect instruction, it embraced it, stating, 'The internal axial force is uniform along the full length'. The ground truth corrects this by removing the instruction, implying that the forces should be calculated for each segment individually, which the Agent did not do.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to fix this inconsistency. It followed the flawed instruction and calculated a single stress level for the entire bar ('Normal stress in each segment: σ = P/A = -30000/200 = -150 MPa'). The ground truth removes this incorrect simplification, but the Agent executed it, thus failing to correct the prompt.
